Let's understand the high-level architecture of Tosca.
The tool is developed with five different components.
Tosca Commander is used to manage the test automation activities
such as development, execution, maintenance and reporting.
Tosca Scan Wizard component allows tester to scan the test application and
create modules. Scanning is used to capture technical
information of AUT. Tosca Executor manages the test
executions and test logs. The test repository is used to store
the test cases, modules, dynamic test data, user information

Skull Server, DB2 are used for this purpose.
